comment: Build-time self-checks for the compiled protection engine (compile_protection.py passes them to aerie_protection_compile). They guard against an empty, truncated or wrongly parsed phishing list. 'listed': hosts the pinned list must cover. The pinned list has no harmless test domain, so these are two real phishing hosts from the pinned file (2026-11-08) and a subdomain of one. ./aerie lists update checks them against the new list before it pins it, and stops when one dropped out: pick another host that the new file holds. 'unlisted': large legitimate sites that must never be listed (a list that holds them is broken or hostile).
